text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What an incredible race...! Especially 
Mejiro Ardan...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was insane, right...? Do you think 
she might actually go toe-to-toe with 
Oguri Cap...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"If we went head-to-head right now, what 
on earth would happen...?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, can't get enough of this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to the next time we go 
at it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...I can feel it.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel a sign... that the 'promised 
history' is beginning to change within 
everyone—)

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan-san! ――Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was able to push past my limits today 
too... It was the greatest race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is no limit to our growth. This race 
made me truly confident of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly... It was a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san. Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I'm truly glad to have you all as my 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In the next race, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: I'll win!

The day after the Takarazuka Kinen. At a 
meeting to decide Mejiro Ardan's next 
goal—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I'd like to challenge Oguri-san.

Mejiro Ardan looked straight into my eyes 
and spoke with clear, resolute certainty.
choice_data_list: So you're saying the time is ripe, huh?
So the time is ripe, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe "now" is precisely that 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...In the recent Takarazuka Kinen, I 
faced Inari-san, who is said to define an 
era."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Her strength was formidable, indeed... 
Yet, I do not believe I was at all 
outmatched."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have... rivals whom I hold dear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's because they were there that I was 
able to elevate myself to a level where I 
can challenge Inari.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When the "current" me faces Oguri-san, 
what kind of result will truly come of it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to try it out... My body is aching 
for it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think? Please let me know 
your thoughts, Trainer.

"Even from my perspective, I feel Mejiro 
Ardan gained extraordinary strength 
through her repeated clashes with her 
rivals."

"As her Trainer, I have no objections to 
taking on Oguri Cap as the culmination of 
this Senior year."
choice_data_list:
Let's make the Tenno Sho (Autumn) our main 
goal.

text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap will definitely be there. 
Because that race is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"A historic stage worthy of a 'turning 
point' in history... indeed. Inevitably, 
those who seek the title of the strongest 
shall gather."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you mentioned a "grand 
objective"—
choice_data_list:
Before that, we're entering the Mainichi 
Okan.

Before that, we'll enter the Mainichi 
Okan.

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to use the Mainichi Okan, the 
prep race for the Tenno Sho (Autumn), to 
make our final adjustments for the 
decisive battle.

Plus, if things go well, Oguri Cap will 
enter too, and we might be able to measure 
her true strength before facing off in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. Starting today, let us take 
our first steps toward the Mainichi Okan.

With an eye on the grand finale's stage— 
First comes the prelude, the Mainichi 
Okan!
